messages:
Maya: Heads up — I'm drafting the migration playbook for private deploy upgrades. Goal: staged rollout with ripcord fallbacks and explicit customer-networking acceptance criteria. Need quick alignment on downtime, installer symmetry, and customer IP preservation.
Ash: we should aim 0 downtime for >90% customers, fallback to read-only during db migrations :grimacing: 
Tom: installer options: slim offline bundle vs operator shim. Which one are we shipping in phase1?
Maya: Phase1: operator shim + minimal offline bundle for airgap customers. Phase2: slim installer with drift detection.
Samira: Customer-managed networking: must preserve source IP and egress IP. docs need concrete checklist for netops (BGP, NAT, IP blocks).
Jorge: Telemetry & KMS: ensure option to disable telemetry and integrate with customer KMS. Also need a stub for offline key provisioning.
Ash: FWlW we need a migration ripcord: switch traffic to hosted model or previous runtime config. How do we orchestrate? Rollback window?
Tom: Rollback window: 30m preferred. We can implement quick rollback by toggling route weights in the control plane. Also add health probes to detect transport errors.
Maya: Acceptance criteria draft: - <10% customer-facing errors; - rollback <30m; - documented netops checklist; - verified offline install on 3 lab topologies. Thoughts?
Samira: Add: IP ownership preservation testcases, step to validate TLS cert rotation with customer CA.
Jorge: suggested config snippet for staged rollout in operator CRD:
```yaml
rollout:
  phases:
    - name: canary
      pct: 5
      rollback_window_mins: 60
    - name: ramp
      pct: 50
      rollback_window_mins: 30
    - name: all
      pct: 100
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: nightly-playbook-draft pushed to gitlab: https://gitlab.redwood/infra/private-deploy-playbook/-/commit/abc123 :rocket:
Maya: Thanks — will merge this into the board. Quick ask: everyone drop ✅/❌ on the acceptance criteria by EOD. I'll consolidate and send to field.
